Shaving does not change how thick or dark hair grows back.
Most colds clear up on their own within about a week.
Food dropped on the floor picks up germs almost immediately.
Toasting bread barely changes how many calories it contains.
Dog saliva does not make a cut heal any faster.
Washing eggs removes their protective coating.
Storing batteries in the freezer can damage them with moisture.
